## What to remember {#revision-essentials}

- Softmax exponentiates each logit and divides it by the sum of exponentials over the vocabulary. The result is a distribution conditioned on the context.
- Adding a common constant to all logits preserves the distribution. Score differences determine probability ratios.
- With temperature T > 0, apply softmax to logits divided by T. Lower temperatures sharpen the distribution and higher ones flatten it. Token selection is a separate operation.
- A normalized distribution sums to 1. With calibration, events assigned 80% probability occur about 80% of the time under a specified population and success criterion. Next-token probability alone does not measure whether an answer is factually true.

## Recall from memory {#revision-check}

Do logits (1, 2) and (11, 12) give different distributions?

<details>
<summary>Show the answer</summary>

No. Adding 10 multiplies all exponential terms by the same constant, which cancels during normalization.

</details>
